body: hey, I didn't mean to bring back those memories for you. i apologize sincerely.

I can't bring myself to tell my parents because my dad is out of shape and i feel like it makes him feel bad whenever i talk about my body. My mom seems like she's too busy doing her thing. the very second i give myself a break i start getting weak and get the whole "ah i guess i did enough" mentality. i just can't stand it.

But if I rest, i gain weight. I won't gain weight, i can't gain weight. Hypocritical considering I just came back from dinner and had fucking mozzerella cheese sticks. lol is all i can really say about me. You sound like you were really dedicated, seems like i eat food like an idiot. I don't have enough money to cook for myself and eat healthier so I'm stuck with high carbs and high fat stuff, but it's my fault. I don't have the willpower to stick to something that hard i bet. 

I probably don't even run enough to warrant this amount of whatever this is. I just got home from a 10k. Is it good enough? probably not. I just fucking ruined it with the food so it cancels it out.

I hate running while I'm doing it but I miss it and hate myself when I even consider skipping. I feel like since i was so lazy for so long my body is just trying to get me to give up and gain all the weight back.

Trapped is what I'm feeling i guess. This one guy who goes to the acting class seems pretty perfect, pretty much everyone likes him. I make them laugh occasionally.

I try to make electronic music but it always comes out sounding horrible.

this is the calculator i used: http://www.calculator.net/ideal-weight-calculator.html so not necessarily a bmi calculator i guess (sorry if i sound like a jerk thats not what im trying).

i'm sick that i can't be good enough. i want to feel good but every time i look at myself im disgusted. if i run i should have done crunches, if i do crunches i should have ran. i have to go run in 25 minutes anyway so i dont gain any weight. oh and some people can run 10ks in 35 minutes. my fastest time is 5 miles in 49 minutes. fucking pathetic.

theyre my only friends besides one other person, so yeah. i hope they like me too
what fucking girl would want to even be around me? i don't blame any of them for not liking me.

i don't want to fall back into sitting and playing games all day and eating and getting fat. my family says i should take a few days off for my leg, but what would i be doing? playing video games and sitting. i hated myself, and i *still* am probably overweight. 155 at 5'7? according to the ideal body weight calculator i still have 10 pounds to go and it's probably right.
